source: First edition: written from established colour-grading practice and kept within this package's physics and intensity rules. The genre baselines come from the user's approved samples (references/taste_profile.md). Updated quarterly; the user approves every update.

natural_clear.name: 自然通透
natural_clear.g_phrase: natural, clear and fresh: true-to-life colours, clean whites, open but still dark shadows, no filter look
natural_clear.fits: almost everything; the default when no style is asked for

warm_film.name: 暖调胶片
warm_film.g_phrase: warm analogue film look: gentle warm highlights, slightly lifted blacks, soft contrast, colours a little muted
warm_film.fits: street, travel, daylight architecture, late-afternoon light
warm_film.avoid: museum showcases and night skies: lifted blacks turn a black background grey

cool_documentary.name: 冷调纪实
cool_documentary.g_phrase: cool documentary look: neutral-to-cool balance, restrained colour, firm contrast, honest light
cool_documentary.fits: city, overcast days, concrete and steel, everyday scenes
cool_documentary.avoid: warm-lit interiors and sunsets: it fights the light that is there

low_key_cinema.name: 暗调电影
low_key_cinema.g_phrase: low-key cinematic look: deep shadows, controlled highlights, subtle cool shadows and warm lit areas, the subject carried by the light already in the scene
low_key_cinema.fits: museum showcases, night, interiors with one main light
low_key_cinema.avoid: bright daylight scenes: they turn murky

high_key_airy.name: 高调清新
high_key_airy.g_phrase: bright and airy look: light, soft, open shadows, clean slightly cool whites, gentle colour
high_key_airy.fits: daylight interiors, still life by a window, white architecture, overcast sky
high_key_airy.avoid: dark showcases and night: it lifts what should stay dark

oriental_elegant.name: 东方雅致
oriental_elegant.g_phrase: quiet East Asian elegance: soft muted greens and greys, warm accents in reds and woods, gentle contrast like ink and lacquer
oriental_elegant.fits: gardens, temples, lacquer, porcelain, calligraphy, wood
oriental_elegant.avoid: neon night streets: it mutes what makes them
